rationale: All runs stay feasible with wide margins; only setup matters. Target and margins are maxed and returns are diminishing (offset vs placement aim: -0.38 at 8.95, -0.26 at 8.32, -0.20 at 8.09), so this DELAY 4/cap213 config is near its wall; remaining levers must move the wall. Across the four floorplans at aim 8.09, T_eff rises monotonically with the core fraction the cells occupy (util/density 0.59->7.893, 0.63->7.960, 0.69->8.026, 0.73->8.149): a bigger die with tighter local packing helps. Setting 1 keeps the best run but uses util 22, density 48% (fraction 0.46). Setting 2 keeps the best floorplan and enables timing-driven placement, untested alone (xnp-002's loss is better blamed on ABC sizing/buffering).
